purpose: Prevent R3 work from becoming orphaned after creation. Every active component must have a resumable state, evidence pointer, next action, blocker, and completion criterion.

active.purpose: Local typed judgment layer under R3, inspired by Jev-compatible decision backends while preserving epistemic provenance and falsifiability.

next_actions: Reconcile r3-judge-v0.1 with current main without dropping branch-only work.

active.completion_criterion: A reconciled branch with passing tests, a create-only admission report, matching model/fingerprint, and an explicit promotion receipt.

anti_starvation.policy: An ACTIVE or CANDIDATE item may not remain without a concrete next action. If work pauses, move it to PARKED with an explicit resume_trigger instead of silently abandoning it.
